_about: All story, tutorial and hint text. Edit freely; {placeholders} are filled in by the game.

forage.title: A quiet clearing
forage.text: Only an old log remains of the forest that once grew here. Something small has sprouted beside it. Tap the mushroom to pick it.

pickClover.title: Seeds of something
pickClover.text: Lovely! It's in your Field Guide now. A clover has popped up too. Pick it. Clovers often drop seeds.

plant.title: Plant a seed
plant.text: You found a Mystery Seed. Plant it on any open tile, and it'll grow while you're away.

dig.title: Something under the soil
dig.text: See that wiggling patch? A geode is buried there. Tap it to dig it up.

crack.title: Crack it open
crack.text: Geodes hide gems, and sometimes something alive. Crack it open!

place.title: A new friend
place.text: Welcome your {creature}! Creatures slowly change the land around them. Place it on an open tile.

watch.title: Watch the land change
watch.text: Stay a moment… your {creature} is already changing the ground around it.

wrap.title: The forest remembers
wrap.text: The forest keeps growing while you're away. Your seed is still sprouting, and new things will appear. Come back and see what changes!

messages.blend: Two influences are meeting! Where they overlap, the land takes on a little of both.
messages.expansion: The forest is spreading. The clearing has grown!
messages.taskDone: Task complete: {task}. Tap Tasks to claim your reward.
messages.tasksIntro: New: Tasks! Little goals to get your forest going, each with a reward.
messages.welcome: Welcome to your clearing. A few things are waiting by the old log, and one of them has a creature inside.
messages.offeringsIntro: The old log remembers what this forest used to hold. Bring it what it asks for, and it gives something back.
messages.firstDelivery: The old log creaks happily. Come back as the forest grows: it will ask for new things.
messages.compostIntro: Spare finds can go on the compost heap. Compost buys small things: recolouring decor and simple props.

landmarks.landmark.old-log: The last remnant of an ancient forest. Moss still clings to it, and something in its rings remembers what this place used to be. The creatures you welcome are slowly bringing that forest back.

teasers.plant.heartwood-sapling: Some say the old forest's heart could sprout again, if the land were ever rich enough.

hints._about: Hints for items not yet in the Field Guide, built from their stat minimums (strongest first). {verb}, {a}, {b}, {c} are filled in.
